The '''Diamond Reserve''' is the fifth floor of the [[Deep Caverns]].

{{ZoneText|The &bDiamond Reserve&f can now be traveled to via the Lift|Mine Diamond Ore.|The Miner Zombies and Skeletons are highly dangerous!}}

== Features ==
The '''Diamond Reserve''' features a few attractions.

=== Lift Operator ===
{{Main|Lift Operator}}
In front of the lift shaft is the {{NPCSprite|Lift Operator}}, who allows players to teleport between layers of the [[Deep Caverns]] with ease. Once the player has entered the '''Diamond Reserve''', it becomes available as a destination in the [[Lift Operator]]'s menu.
